evidence.title: GitHub - ErKeLost/wallhaven-desktop: wallhaven Wallpaper software desktop

name: Wallhaven Desktop
summary: Tauri desktop client for browsing and downloading wallpapers from the Wallhaven service.
description: Desktop wallpaper client for the Wallhaven API built with Tauri, React 19, Farm and shadcn/ui. Wallhaven API requests are proxied through a local service (wallhaven.fun) so wallpapers stay reachable from networks that block the site. Work in progress; builds are distributed through GitHub releases.
contains: Tauri desktop client for the Wallhaven wallpaper API
stack: Farm bundler, React 19, Tauri, shadcn/ui, Radix UI
Wallhaven API calls proxied through wallhaven.fun so browsing works on restricted networks
builds distributed via GitHub releases; macOS install note (xattr quarantine fix)
